items.title: Remove caravan and wooden extension
items.quote: Sie haben den auf dem Grundstück Fl.-Nr. 412/3 abgestellten Wohnwagen samt dem angebauten Holzvorbau bis spätestens 26.02.2027 zu entfernen.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date by which the caravan and wooden extension must be removed: 26.02.2027. No calculation needed; this is the final day stated verbatim in the Bescheid (Nr. 1).

items.title: File Klage (court action) against the Bescheid
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie binnen eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Klage beim Bayerischen Verwaltungsgericht Musterregensburg, Haidplatz 4, 93047 Musterregensburg erheben, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Geschäftsstelle des Gerichts.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 18.11.2026, sent by ordinary post. Letter itself states the authority's deemed-delivery rule: 'gilt am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben' (Art. 41 Abs. 2 BayVwVfG) — 4th day after posting = Sun 22.11.2026 (this day does not shift for deemed-delivery purposes). Start of the one-month Klage period runs from the day after deemed delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB): 23.11.2026. One month later (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) = Tue 22.12.2026, which falls on a working day, so no further shift (§ 57 Abs. 2 VwGO, § 222 Abs. 2 ZPO). Final day the Klage must reach the Verwaltungsgericht Musterregensburg: 22.12.2026. (A tool cross-check flagged that Bayern kept a 3-day deemed-delivery rule for matters begun before 1 January 2025 under Art. 98 BayVwVfG; the letter's own text, however, explicitly applies the 4-day rule, so that older exception appears not to apply here.)

items.title: Threatened Zwangsgeld (coercive fine) of 2,000 € if removal is late
items.quote: Für den Fall, dass Sie Nr. 1 nicht rechtzeitig erfüllen, wird ein Zwangsgeld von 2.000 € angedroht.
items.computation: This is a conditional threat (Zwangsgeldandrohung), not a current payment demand: it only becomes due if the removal ordered in Nr. 1 is not completed by its deadline of 26.02.2027. The relevant trigger date is therefore the same as the removal deadline in item 1.

warnings: The letter does not demand any immediate payment; the 2,000 € Zwangsgeld is only a threat that would become payable if the caravan/extension is not removed by 26.02.2027 — do not pay it now and verify any later payment request through the Landratsamt's known contact details before transferring money.

The deemed-delivery and Klage-deadline calculation assumes the letter was actually posted on its printed date (18.11.2026); if the envelope's postmark or your own receipt date differs, the one-month deadline (currently computed as 22.12.2026) could shift — confirm the actual posting/receipt date.
Filing a Klage is a formal court action; consider getting advice (e.g. a lawyer or Verbraucherzentrale) well before the 22.12.2026 deadline, as this tool cannot draft or file it for you.

The printed IBAN (DE88 7435 1000 0002 0007 00) is structurally valid and matches a German Sparkasse, but no payment is currently requested on this letter — only use this IBAN if a later legitimate payment request from the Landratsamt refers to it.
